SIGN_CONVENTION: SELECTIVE minus SHAM, on the paired log difference
PAIRED_TEST: Wilcoxon signed-rank, two-sided, alpha 0.05, Pratt zeros, exact conditional sign-flip distribution by dynamic programming — no normal approximation
COMBINATION: intersection-union AND with concordant median direction
ACCRUAL_RULE: process the frozen base seeds in index order until 41 technically valid admissible pairs are retained, or the hard 512-arm-instance ceiling is exhausted. A base seed without an admissible trigger consumes its predeclared cost and may not be replaced.
ONE_ARM_INSTANCE: one full-horizon world-equivalent of engine work, T = 11000 steps
PREFIX_TRUNCATION: the common prefix is run only to the frozen LATEST_ALLOWED_TRIGGER = 6500, because a candidate after that step fails the frozen deadline gate and no trigger is possible. This uses the frozen rule and changes no definition. Arm instances are created only for admissible seeds and always run the full horizon.

METHODS_CLOSURE_DISAGREEMENT.WHAT_IS_BOUND: the UNION, 24 files. A superset closure can only over-bind, never leave an executing file unhashed, and no file is in runtime-only.
